answer: A diversity threshold stops fake identities. Trading rights require 12 unrelated counterparties over 20 epochs, no partner over 20% of volume; a timber seller cannot qualify using its clones. A willow nursery counts only if audited separately. A zephyr-powered courier counts only if independent. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 ties at 15 credits each, or 180,000 credits; one honest agent pays 180 and keeps undiluted rewards.
